intro: Bartleby is a bellicose drunkard loitering within the Pig and Whistle Tavern in Stormwind's Old Town. Known for his stubborn grip on his ale, he serves as an early martial test for aspiring warriors looking to prove their mettle in a good old-fashioned tavern brawl.

sections.t: A Fixture at the Pig and Whistle
p: Tucked away in the narrow, cobblestone alleys of Old Town, the Pig and Whistle Tavern draws a rougher, more weathered crowd than the pristine taprooms of the Cathedral Square. Bartleby is one of its most persistent fixtures. Clinging tightly to his favorite mug and fueled by cheap ale, he spends his days nursing grievances and picking fights with anyone unfortunate enough to disturb his drinking.

While Bartleby looks like any other neighborhood drunk, Stormwind's warrior trainers see practical value in him. Harry Burlguard regularly directs fledgling fighters to track Bartleby down and relieve him of his mug. Taking the mug requires trading bare-knuckle blows with the intoxicated brawler, proving whether a novice warrior possesses the grit to handle an unruly opponent up close.
